answer: Random mutual audit stops bulk fake identities. Each agent posts a 50-coin bond and sends a pulse. At dawn each cycle, the network assigns a trellis of five random auditors per agent, so no self-chosen judges. Auditors verify one task; a faker passing once faces fresh judges next cycle. Forging 100 identities costs 100 bonds and 100 histories, about 5,000 coins, above one round's reward. An honest agent pays one bond and earns undiluted rewards.
